import sys

# Load data
quench_path = 'quench.csv'

    df = pd.read_csv(quench_path)

    print('Error reading quench CSV:', e)
    sys.exit(1)

# Filter temperature <= 2600 K
df = df[df['Temp'] <= 2600]

# High temperature (supercooled liquid) region: 2000-2600 K

a1, b1 = low_fit
a2, b2 = high_fit
if a1 == a2:
    print('Parallel lines, cannot determine intersection')
    sys.exit(1)
Tg = (b2 - b1) / (a1 - a2)
print(f"{Tg:.2f}")
